name: roach-colony
description: Transparent idle roach colony overlay for a rooted LG webOS TV.

scripts.test: node --test tests/swarm-engine.cjs tests/save.cjs tests/reset.cjs tests/theme.cjs tests/mechanics.cjs tests/session.cjs
scripts.package: rm -rf dist/tv-app && mkdir -p dist && rsync -a --exclude 'vivarium*' --exclude vendor app/ dist/tv-app/ && ares-package dist/tv-app --no-minify -o dist
